title: Report a traffic crash with NSW Police
summary: This page provides information on when and how to report a traffic crash to NSW Police.
who_can_apply: The situation is not an emergency or life threatening.
You are no longer at the scene of the crash.
No persons were seriously injured or killed.
All drivers, riders, and owners have exchanged particulars.
You require a NSW Police Event number for insurance purposes.
what_you_need: Your email address to receive a verification code.
contact: If you have any questions call the Police Assistance Line on 131444 (24 hours, 7 days).

faqs.q: When should I call Triple Zero?
faqs.a: Call Triple Zero if the incident is happening now, you are still at the scene, a driver or owner left without exchanging details, a driver appears under the influence, the suspect is still at the scene, or anyone is seriously injured or in immediate danger.

faqs.q: When can I report a minor traffic crash online?
faqs.a: You can report a minor crash online if it is not an emergency, you are no longer at the scene, no one was seriously injured or killed, all parties exchanged details, and you require a NSW Police Event number for insurance.

faqs.q: Who should I call if I have questions about reporting a crash?
faqs.a: Call the Police Assistance Line on 131444, which is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
